policy.defaultNumerator: Actual API-priced end-user-reported use or reported estimate anchored to measured use; exact model, tier and dates required.

selectedSourceException.evidenceType: Controlled subscription-account measurements with agentic workload projections.

policy.gptApplication: User authorizes the same ChatGPT plan multiples for every GPT model. Owner decision O45 (2026-10-23): GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra keep their own SemiAnalysis figures on every ChatGPT plan, bound to each model's unsuffixed (max) row because SemiAnalysis names the models without an effort; every other GPT row (other GPT models and GPT-6.1 Sol at xhigh, high, medium and low, ranked as their own rows under O33) takes, per plan, the lower of the two reported model-conditional figures as a labelled user assumption naming its donor route. Routes are one row per model and plan.
policy.routeGranularity: Owner decision O45 (2026-10-23): every route row names exactly one model and one plan.
policy.mimoApplication: Owner decision O46 (2026-10-23), an explicit exception to the end-user numerator rule: each MiMo-V2.6 model takes, per Token Plan tier, the quota-implied ceiling (the tier's monthly credits valued at Xiaomi's pay-as-you-go rate for that model, divided by the list fee), labelled provider-derived. It replaces the 2026-10-08 provisional 1.5x assumption. An end-user measurement for the exact model and tier replaces the ceiling when one exists.
policy.unsupportedModels: Use API fallback; do not transfer evidence across model versions, variants or thinking effort except for the explicit common GPT, Claude and MiMo assumptions.
policy.claudeApplication: User authorizes (2026-10-18, Option 2) applying Opus 5.5's measured SemiAnalysis Claude plan multiples to every other Claude model. Opus 5.5 keeps its exact measured routes; the shared routes are labelled user assumptions, carry the recorded caution that allowances are model-specific (Fable 5.1 measured 12.4-12.7x on the same plans), and are superseded by any exact measurement for the listed model. Claude Fable 5.1 (retained 2026-10-21, owner decision O31) has exact SemiAnalysis measurements on Max 5x (12.73x) and Max 20x (12.425x), which replace the shared routes for it; it has no Pro route, because the source records Fable as unavailable on Pro, so there is no Pro allowance to measure or assume. Owner decision O33 (2026-10-21) ranks Claude Haiku 5.5 (max, high, medium, low) and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (xhigh, high, medium, low) as their own rows; as other Claude models in the roster they take the shared assumption routes.

routes.planLabel: MiMo Token Plan Lite $6 · quota ceiling (provider-derived)
routes.evidenceLabel: Provider quota ceiling (owner decision O46; not a measurement)
routes.notes: Owner decision O46 (2026-10-23): the quota-implied ceiling, not a measurement. Xiaomi's Token Plan Lite costs $6 a month for 4.1 billion credits; at Xiaomi's overseas pay-as-you-go rates MiMo-V2.6-Pro burns credits worth $1.44 (cache hit) to $1.45 (uncached input and output) per billion credits; the lower is used, so the full monthly quota is worth $5.90 of API use, 0.984x the list fee, at day rates, without the 12% first-purchase or annual discounts or the 0.8x night rate. A subscriber can realise at most this; no end-user measurement of a V2.6 billing period existed on 2026-10-23 (deep research and Perplexity, research/2026-10-23-mimo-token-plans/). Replaces the 2026-10-08 provisional 1.5x assumption.

A subscriber can realise at most this; no end-user measurement of a V2.6 billing period existed on 2026-10-23 (deep research and Perplexity, research/2026-10-23-mimo-token-plans/). Replaces the 2026-10-08 provisional 1.5x assumption.
